note: techniques-2026: known generator watermark messages. A decoded mark is linked to a generator ONLY on an exact match with an entry here (bit-for-bit for imwatermark; the bit-accuracy rule of the entry for neural decoders). The table is versioned: a change bumps 'version' and the output generation. An empty algorithm list means no public, verified generator message is known — a decoded message is then recorded as a fact only.

entries.limitations: The message is public and the invisible-watermark library (MIT) can embed it into any image, so a match shows that the SDXL watermarker (or someone imitating it) marked the pixels — like a generator metadata field. Pipelines run with add_watermarker=False, images under 256 px wide and SD3/FLUX diffusers pipelines carry no such mark.

entries.generator: Resemble AI PerTh 암묵 워터마커(Chatterbox가 모든 출력에 기본 삽입)
entries.source: https://github.com/resemble-ai/chatterbox/blob/5de7a54aa4e5e2baadb0182dde554908b48b85c2/src/chatterbox/tts.py (L126 self.watermarker = perth.PerthImplicitWatermarker(); L271 apply_watermark) and src/chatterbox/vc.py (L29, L103); README 'Built-in PerTh Watermarking for Responsible AI'; decoder weights: resemble-perth 1.0.1 wheel (MIT)
entries.limitations: The implicit PerTh mark has no message: a detection is one bit. Resemble AI's own services and anyone using the MIT library embed the same mark, so a match is a moderate synthetic-direction item that only blocks an authenticity conclusion; it never names Chatterbox as the generator by itself.
entries.min_confidence_basis: Measured 2026-10-17 on 240 LibriSpeech dev-clean utterances: unmarked max 0.780 (3 of 240 >= 0.5), marked (apply_watermark, 16-bit) min 0.922; 0 unmarked >= 0.9.

algorithms.imwatermark-dwtDct: invisible-watermark dwtDct; match = all bits equal (exact)
algorithms.videoseal-1.0: Meta Video Seal 1.0, 256 bits; match = at least min_agreement_bits (default 243) equal bits — no entry registered
algorithms.audioseal-16: Meta AudioSeal, 16 bits; match = all 16 bits equal after a detection — no entry registered
algorithms.perth-implicit: Resemble AI PerTh implicit watermark (resemble-perth 1.0.1, perth_net_250000); presence fact = confidence >= 0.5 (the package's rounding); registry match = confidence >= the entry's min_confidence and expected_payload "1" — moderate, never a conclusion (1 bit)

unregistered_algorithms.trustmark: TrustMark payloads are IDs (e.g. a soft-binding key), not generator names; a payload is linked to a manifest only by matching a valid manifest's c2pa.soft-binding value — never to a generator by this table.
unregistered_algorithms.videoseal: No public, verified generator message for VideoSeal/PixelSeal (2026-10). Meta does not document which messages its products embed.
unregistered_algorithms.audioseal: No public, verified generator message for AudioSeal 16-bit messages (2026-10).
